description: This walk follows a lovely section of the Norfolk Coast from West Runton to Cromer. There's nice views along the coast from the cliff top path on this 2.5 mile route which runs along a fairly easy path. For a longer circular walk try our Cromer to Sheringham Walk which also visits Beeston Cliffs.

details.subtitle: Further Information and Other Local Ideas
details.content: Head south from the village and you can enjoy a climb to Beacon Hill and Beeston Bump on the West Runton and Beeston Bump Circular Walk. For more walking ideas in the area see the Norfolk Walks page.
